parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe the main teachings of Hadith 75.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Explain how the Prophet (pbuh) reacted to the death of his friends and family. You must refer
to Quʾran 3.144 and any other verse from the Qurʾan or Hadith that you have studied.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
‘To what extent should Muslims today remember the dead?’ Discuss this statement with
reference to different points of view. 
EITHER

text: Read the following text passages then answer the questions which follow.
IbnʿAbbas (May Allah be pleased with them) reported that the Messenger of Allah (pbuh) used
“O Allah! To You I have submitted, and in You do I believe, and in You I put my trust, to You do
I turn, and for You I argued. O Allah, I seek refuge with You through Your Power; there is none
worthy of worship except You Alone; that You safeguard me against going astray. You are
the Ever Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists; the One Who never dies,
whereas human beings and jinn will all die”.
Muhammad is no more than a messenger: many Were the messenger that passed away
before him. If he died or were slain, will ye then Turn back on your heels? If any did turn back
on his heels, not the least harm will he do to Allah; but Allah (on the other hand) will swiftly
reward those who (serve Him) with gratitude.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain the importance of making the right intention (niyyah) in Islam.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Fasting is the most private act of worship (ibadah) in Islam.’ Evaluate this statement. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain how the revealed word of God acts as guidance to Muslims.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘It is necessary for Muslims to pray for guidance.’ Evaluate this statement.
